About RouteIQ

Plan a round trip that visits every stop and returns to the starting point. RouteIQ turns route planning into a visual strategy challenge: a small change in the order of your stops can change the total distance.

How to play

  1. Choose a route through every stop, starting and ending at A.
  2. Compare your route with the optimal route to see where you can improve.
  3. Try another puzzle and refine your route-planning strategy.
